$comment: Behavior-based segmentation. Each sentence a prospect can click carries signals that route toward one of four tracks. Edit copy freely; keep the signal keys so the router still works. Signals: fault_line, backlog, board, renewal, new_ciso, audit, no_scanner, curious.

sentences.text: My scanner keeps generating. My IT team keeps missing SLA.
Board asks for time-to-fix. I can't answer.
Findings die in email between security and infra.
I've been prioritizing forever and the queue only grows.
My hardening tool renews in the next six months and I'm not thrilled.
My scanner renews in the next six months and I'm not thrilled.
New CISO landed in the last twelve months. Everything's on the table.
Audit is breathing down my neck.
I don't have a scanner. I'm not sure I want one.
We're a newer program. I'm figuring out what stack to build.
Honestly, just reading up on the space.
Shadow AI is a growing problem I don't have a handle on.
